stories.title: Uganda: Bus Operators Hike Fares, Warn of More Increases in December
stories.summary: [Nile Post] Bus operators in Kampala have increased transport fares following a sharp rise in fuel prices, adding to the cost of travel for passengers heading to different parts of the country ahead of the December festive season.

stories.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Jubilee Asset Management Limited has opened a financial advisory centre in Meru, expanding its services to the Mt. Kenya and Upper Eastern regions.
